The Dan Wootton Show
11-11-2020 • 45 minutos
In the thick of a second lockdown Dan asks if you have fallen out with friends and family over Covid restrictions, it's seated by late editor at the i Newspaper Benjamin Butterworth and Spiked Online writer Paddy Hannam. The big political stories of the day are discussed by Labour adviser James Mills and commentator Emily Carver. Samantha Markle responds to her sister's Remembrance Sunday display and Mark Dolan weighs in on the UK's obesity crisis. Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.
